notes.val_seeds: Chosen before any training: the last 15 bulk seeds and the last 5 of each hard-case set of render run v1, so validation has the same mix as training. Never test seeds.
notes.stride: Every 5th frame (5 fps): nearer frames are near copies of each other.
notes.resolution: 640, divisible by patch 16 x windows 2. At the default 512 the median ball is 7.1 px (docs/eval/dataset-stats.json); 640 gives about 8.9 px for a 1.6x cost. Larger is a measured ablation, not a default.
notes.batch: 4 images, gradients accumulated 4 times: an effective batch of 16, rfdetr's default target, within a laptop GPU's memory.
notes.epochs: Up to 12 with early stopping on validation mAP (patience 5). Set for compute, before the full run: on an Apple GPU (MPS) an epoch of v1 (9,750 images at 640) takes about 54 min (measured: 0.32 s per training image), so 30 epochs would take about 27 h; Azure has no GPU quota. 12 epochs is about 11 h.
notes.seed: Fixed so a rerun on the same data gives the same model, up to GPU nondeterminism.
